Slow drains? Let's clear the whole line.

Deep cleaning of sewer lines to restore full flow. We don't just poke a hole through the clog. We clean the pipe so it drains the way it should.

Flow: a trickle

Call (844) 212-9186

What's usually in the way

Most blocked sewer lines come down to one of these four.

Grease and soap scum
It goes down the drain as liquid and cools into a coating on the pipe walls. It builds up layer by layer.
Tree roots
They slip into joints looking for water, then grow into thick mats that catch everything else.
Wipes and paper
Even wipes sold as flushable don't break down like toilet paper. They pile up and snag on rough spots.
Scale and mineral buildup
Hard water leaves crusty deposits that slowly narrow the pipe.

Cable machine or jetting?

Both clean the line. They just work differently, and we pick based on what we find.

Cable machine

A rotating cable with a cutting head goes in through the cleanout. It breaks up clogs and cuts through roots.

Works best for

A clog, roots or a stubborn blockage in an otherwise sound pipe.

Hydro jetting

A hose sends high-pressure water through the line and scrubs the pipe walls clean.

Works best for

Heavy grease, scale or buildup along the whole length of the pipe.

Signs it's time for a cleaning

  • Slow drains in more than one fixture
  • Gurgling when you flush or run the washer
  • Water coming up in the tub or a floor drain
  • A sewer smell inside or near the cleanout
  • The lowest drain in the house backs up first

Keeping it from coming back

  • Wipes, paper towels and cotton swabs go in the trash, not the toilet.
  • Let cooking grease cool, then bin it. Wipe pans before washing.
  • Got big trees near the line? Ask us about regular cleaning before it backs up.

If it clogs again fast, the pipe itself may be damaged. We'll check it with a camera.

Get your sewer line flowing again.

Tell us what your drains are doing. We'll work out whether you need a cleaning, jetting or a closer look with a camera.
